slides.title: Let's Explore the City!
bullets: Prepare to read, discuss and write
slides.narration: Welcome to Grade 2 English, Unit 9: Let's Explore the City! This is the last unit of Year 2, and it takes you into a busy city. You learn the names of city places such as the library, the market, the shopping centre and the Ferris wheel, and the words you need to get around: bus, underground, ferry, map, directions and straight ahead. At the city aquarium you meet the octopus, the penguin, the turtle and the shark, and describe them with words like amazing, clever, huge and beautiful. You say what you like and don't like, give true facts in the present simple, and talk about what you did yesterday and what you will do tomorrow, just like Amal and her brother Adam in this unit's story, “A Big Day in the City”. In this short lecture, preview the key ideas and prepare for the independent lesson.

slides.title: What you will achieve
bullets: Name common places in a city, such as the library, shopping centre, underground and ferry.
Talk about city sounds and the things you see, such as traffic and a helicopter.
Say what you like and don't like, and agree or disagree politely.
slides.narration: By the end of this unit, you will be able to name common places in a city, such as the library, shopping centre, underground and ferry. You will also talk about city sounds and the things you see, such as traffic and a helicopter. You will also say what you like and don't like, and agree or disagree politely. Keep these goals in mind as you work.

slides.title: Words to learn
slides.narration: Your vocabulary work begins with these words: bike, while, hope, note, stone, phone. Listen to each word, look at what it means, and try to use it when you talk and write.

slides.title: Read and think
bullets: Point to the words that show it
slides.narration: The reading sequence includes A Poem: “At the Zebra Crossing” and The Aquarium Schedule. Read slowly, look at the pictures, and find the big idea in each text. When you answer a question, point to the words that show it.

slides.title: Likes and Dislikes
bullets: In a busy city there is so much to do. We use like and don't like to say what we enjoy and what we do not enjoy, and we can agree or disagree with a...
Try it in your own sentences
slides.narration: The first language focus is Likes and Dislikes. In a busy city there is so much to do. We use like and don't like to say what we enjoy and what we do not enjoy, and we can agree or disagree with a friend without being rude. Look at the examples, then try the pattern in your own sentences.

slides.title: Use English for a real purpose
bullets: Say it, write it, make it better
slides.narration: In speaking, you will complete Speaking 1 — Talk About City Places. Say your ideas clearly and listen to your partner. In writing, you will draw, trace, copy or write, then check your work with a grown-up or the AI tutor.

slides.title: You are ready to begin
bullets: Activities, quiz and optional live sessions
slides.narration: You are ready to begin. Start with the words, then the reading and the questions, then the grammar, speaking and writing. Ask the AI tutor for help any time, and bring your questions to a live session too if you join one.
